summary: Phase 3 (Tasks 9,10,11,13) e2e test. Backend: new pytest suite test_phase3_iter13.py — 15/15 pass (refund partial/full + status transitions + role gating + refunds report with date filter; service charge PUT/GET/per-order PATCH and pay math (3.00 -> 3.30 @10%); reservations CRUD + date filter + link-reservation deposit subtracted on pay; stop list CRUD + products is_available + cleared on new shift). Edge suite test_phase3_edge_iter13.py exposed 3 validation gaps. Frontend: found and fixed a CRITICAL crash that made the whole /pos screen unusable (TDZ ReferenceError), then verified stop toggle/dimming/blocking toast, checkout service-charge toggle + pay-total, payment; /admin/loyalty SC settings persist; /admin/reports 'Возвраты' tab; /admin/reservations create/status/date-filter/delete. All test data cleaned up and service_charge_default_enabled reset to false.

minor.issue: No existence check on the order: linking a non-existent order id returns 200 {success:true} and still marks the reservation 'seated' with order_id set to the bogus id (prepaid silently lost). Should 404 when the order is missing (and ideally reject non-open orders).
status accepts any arbitrary string (e.g. 'banana' -> 200). Frontend only renders pending/seated/cancelled/done, so bad data breaks the status select colour/label. Add an enum validator.
items=[] with reason='' is accepted and creates a 0 ₽ refund record that shows up in /api/reports/refunds. Require at least one item and a non-empty reason.
Settings doc is keyed only by {key:'venue'} with no restaurant_id — service_charge_percent/default are shared across tenants (pre-existing pattern, but new Task 10 fields inherit the leak).
Only get_current_user — a waiter can create/patch/delete reservations (incl. deposits) and edit the stop list. Confirm whether this is intended; if not, gate with require_roles.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL (FIXED BY TESTER): `useEffect(... , [settings])` for the service-charge default was placed on line 44, before `const { data: settings } = useQuery(...)` on line 60 -> ReferenceError 'Cannot access settings before initialization' on every render. The entire POS screen (cashier/waiter workstation) rendered a blank page / red runtime-error overlay. Fixed by moving the useEffect below the settings query; POS verified working afterwards. Please keep this ordering.
No client-side validation: submitting an empty form fires a 422 and shows the raw, non-localized toast 'Field required Field required' in an otherwise Russian UI.
'Время до' (time_to) has no input even though the backend model and the list rendering (`time_from–time_to`) support it.
Delete button removes a reservation (with deposit) immediately, with no confirmation dialog and no success toast.

integration_issues.issue: Receipt/print shows items 3.00 then ИТОГО 3.30 with no 'Сервисный сбор 10%' line (same for reservation prepaid_amount) — the guest cannot see why the total differs from the item sum.

issues: Native browser <input type=date> is used instead of the shadcn calendar component used elsewhere in the design system
Stop toggle is a <span> nested inside the product <button> — it works via stopPropagation but is not keyboard/a11y reachable and has no title/aria-label ('⊘' glyph only)

action_items: Do NOT regress the Pos.jsx hook ordering fix (useEffect must come after the settings useQuery) — it was a hard crash of the whole POS page.
link-reservation: 404 when the order does not exist; do not mark the reservation seated in that case.
Validate reservation status against pending/seated/cancelled/done (Pydantic enum).
Reject refunds with no items / empty reason (400) so 0 ₽ rows stop appearing in the refunds report.
Add client-side validation + localized errors to the reservation create modal; add a 'Время до' field and a delete confirmation.
Show a 'Сервисный сбор X%' (and 'Предоплата/депозит') line on the receipt and precheck.
Decide role gating for /api/reservations and /api/pos/stop-list (waiter currently has full write access).
Consider scoping the settings document by restaurant_id (service charge is currently global across tenants).
critical_code_review_comments: Pos.jsx: hooks referencing a value declared later in the component body throw a TDZ ReferenceError at render — always declare queries before effects that depend on them; this pattern should be caught by a lint rule (no-use-before-define) since it took the whole cashier screen down.

server.py refund_order silently clamps qty to it['count'] but does not track already-refunded quantities per item index, so the same item can be refunded repeatedly (total_refunded only gates the 'refunded' status flag, not the amount) — a cashier can refund more money than the order total.
server.py link_reservation takes a raw dict body instead of a Pydantic model and does not validate the order exists or is open.
settings collection is not multi-tenant scoped ({key:'venue'} only).

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 feature tests); 3 of 4 edge/validation checks failed
success_rate.frontend: 100% after fixing the POS crash (0% before — POS was completely unusable)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the phase-3 suites serially: `python -m pytest tests/test_phase3_iter13.py -n 0`. The class order matters (TestStopList closes/reopens the shift). After testing, run tests/cleanup_iter13.py (removes TEST refunds/corrections/reservations, clears stop list, resets service charge to 10%/off). Login helpers: manager tab is 'Менеджер' and the email/password fields are prefilled — just click 'Войти'. POS login = click digits 2222 on the PIN pad. Products in 'Бургеры' all have modifier groups (a picker opens); use the 'Напитки' category for simple add-to-cart flows.
rca_of_the_issue: POS blank screen: in Pos.jsx the service-charge default useEffect was inserted immediately after the useState declarations, but its dependency array `[settings]` is evaluated during render while `const settings` (react-query) is declared ~16 lines later — a const TDZ access -> 'Cannot access settings before initialization' thrown on first render, unmounting the whole <Pos> tree (React error overlay, empty body). Reproduced by logging in with PIN 2222 and observing the pageerror. Fix applied: move the useEffect after the settings useQuery declaration; POS then rendered and the full stop-list + service-charge + payment flow passed.
